sections.strategic_report: strategic report for the year ended 31 March 2024. Review of the business Johnsons 1871 Limited is one of the UKs' leading workplace support companies, supporting corporate and public sector clients with their complex and demanding workspace projects. The various brands support clients in a full turnkey offering supporting both new and existing locations. Offering design, fit out, business moves, storage, installation services, specialist laboratory relocations, facilities support services, IT support services and the original home removals service. The company provides a full in house, project management service and delivers seamless physical relocation and installation of workspace, furnishings, documents and IT equipment so that relocated staff simply turn up at their new facility and can operate immediately post move. The aligned storage solutions we provide are also highly valued and revenues and capacity is expanding as organisations seek flexibility to transform and manage their property estate or seek storage solutions for complex asset management requirements. These highly valued capabilities further underline our position in the workplace support sector. For many organisations, the integrated services we can provide simplifies a complex logistics challenge. With a team of around 200 staff and operating a fleet of 120 vehicles from 9 sites across the UK, we have the size and experience to manage significant complexity and scale and can flex resources to accommodate demanding timetables required by clients seeking to minimise downtime. Customer satisfaction is very high and whilst one-off moves are critical, over half of our revenue is generated through incremental activity from existing customers who typically develop a close and long-term partnership with us. Throughout the year we have continued to transformation the business structure to better provide focused expertise to our customers. We also continue to continuously look for opportunities to elevate our drive to achieve the following: Sustainability - achieving EcoVardis status and setting key deliverables for the reduction of waste and carbon. Digitisation - improving customer experience via unique software. Innovation - looking at new offerings and technology to help our clients achieve their own strategic aims. During the last year the business has continued to evolve and expand our service offerings, with the addition of new services to compliment the core business, we are now offering clients expertise in all areas of their workplace. Revenues for the year grew from £24,379,570 in the year to March 2023 to £29,280,610 in the year to March 2024, an increase of 20.1%. Profit before tax decreased from £2,169,576 in March 2023 to a profit before tax of £176,537 in March 2024, a decrease of 91.8%.
